name: 巴卢克
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4536
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 209）｜白骸骨匠人家，中｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇定顶上一档；白骸的骨匠在刃和骨甲上刻字，不烧炉不用魔晶，骨刻甲配指节骨刃，拆机甲那一手照页上写。
who: Baluk, a demon-kin of the White Bone folk, a bone-carver and a legend who has looked in his mid-twenties ever since the night his name was made: very tall, about 193 cm, narrow-shouldered, with long arms, long legs and long fingers. Ash-pale grey-white skin. Short hair of a very pale lilac. Two bone horns at the temples sweeping backward, unmatched: the left one long and the right one short (the long horn on the viewer's right when he faces us). Grey-green eyes, very faint eyebrows, thin lips, level eye corners. Small bone ridges along the outside of every knuckle, so a closed hand looks like a row of folded little knives. His clothes are always neat, the cuffs rolled to exactly the same width. No jewelry. A cool, fastidious, quietly careful air.
build: 193 cm, tall and lean: narrow shoulders, long arms and legs, long-fingered hands, a narrow waist.
palette: ash grey-white, pale lilac, bone ivory, grey-green, soot black
casual: His workshop wear in the bone-carvers' camp: a close-fitting charcoal wool tunic that closes down the front with small bone buttons, the sleeves rolled to the forearm in two exactly equal cuffs, a long dark leather work apron with a row of slim bone-handled picks and pry tools in narrow pockets across the chest, dark trousers tucked into soft grey boots. In his left hand he holds a small bone bird with one pin missing from its neck, its head tilted to one side. He stands straight, looking down at it with a level, measuring look.
private: Resting at night: a loose long-sleeved pale grey linen shirt buttoned to the collar, the cuffs still rolled evenly, soft dark trousers and felt slippers. He turns a single small iron washer between his long fingers, checking its edge, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Unmaking the war machines as a legend, in the finest harness the White Bone carvers ever made: a long close-fitting coat of dark grey leather plated over the chest, shoulders and forearms with carved bone scales, every scale cut with fine bone-script that glows cold white; a high gorget of bone plates; narrow bone vambraces left open at the knuckles. Thin hard bone blades have sprung out from the outside of all ten knuckles, their edges glowing white, and a line of white light runs from his fingertips as if tracing a seam in the air, loosened bolts and plates hanging beside him in a neat row. A low, careful stance, the face cool and intent.
formal: At a gathering of the bone-carvers' camp: a long charcoal wool coat that closes down the front with polished bone buttons, fitted sleeves with the cuffs turned back to exactly equal width, a narrow collar of carved bone plates at the neck, a wide black leather belt, dark trousers and polished boots; the small tilted bone bird sits in his open right palm. He stands very straight, a calm, reserved look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the face turned three-quarters, the grey-green eyes lowered to the small bone bird with its tilted head held up near his face, the mouth closed with the faintest hidden smile. Cold white light from the glowing script on his knuckle blades lights his face from below, dark night behind. Foreground blur: a neat row of loose iron plates and bolts hanging in the air, and drifting ash. He wears the charcoal tunic with the evenly rolled cuffs.

name: 雅莎
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4491
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 210）｜峭壁低处人家，贫｜照常（不拿兵器，翼缘就是刃）｜5档｜撼世传奇定顶上一档；有翼魔族这一段扑塔用骨矛，她靠翼缘的风刃，战装是让开翼根的黑漆骨甲。
who: Yasha, a winged demon-kin of the western sea cliffs, a legend who has looked in her mid-twenties ever since her name was made: tall, about 179 cm, long-limbed and lean, the muscles at her waist and legs clearly defined, two thick muscles at the wing roots. Short purple-black hair clinging to the nape. Bright orange eyes, a high nose bridge. A great pair of feathered wings, the inner side near black, the outer edge lined with a band of dark red hard feathers, spanning two rooms when spread. No horns, ordinary ears. A small double-holed whistle hangs from the leather strap at her wing root. A fierce, vivid, teasing air, the shoulders always thrown back as if about to dive into the wind.
build: 179 cm, tall and lean: strong shoulders with thick wing-root muscles across the upper back, a full E-cup, a narrow defined waist, rounded hips and long muscular legs.
palette: purple-black, bright orange, dark red, near-black feather, sea-foam white
casual: Her everyday wear on the cliffs: a sleeveless dark sea-green leather jerkin cut open at the back for the wings, the opening edged with soft leather, over a close-fitting black long-sleeved shirt opened the same way, dark leather trousers and soft wrapped climbing boots; a leather strap across the chest to the wing roots with the small double-holed whistle hanging on it. Her wings are half open and she is shaking sea water off the feathers. She stands with her hands on her hips, grinning and showing her teeth.
private: Home after a long flight: a loose long-sleeved grey linen shirt open at the back for the wings, plain dark trousers, barefoot, the wings folded and damp. She holds two broken red-edged feathers in one hand, a warm, tired, softened look.
battle: Skimming the storm waves as a legend: a fitted war harness of overlapping dark bone plates lacquered black across the chest and shoulders, every plate edged in dull red and carved with faint red-glowing script, leaving the wing roots and the open back free; black leather bracers and greaves with bone guards; the double-holed whistle on its strap at the wing root. Her wings are spread wide and swept forward, and from the dark red hard feathers along each wing edge streams a curved black blade of wind with a red rim, two great scything arcs on either side of her. Leaning into the dive, teeth bared, the orange eyes blazing.
formal: Before the cliff clans at a gathering: a long fitted coat of deep red-black wool that closes down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, the back cut open for the wings, a broad belt of plaited black leather, the whistle on a fine chain at her throat, the wings folded neatly behind her. She stands proud with her chin raised and a bold half smile.
art: A dynamic portrait from slightly below, the face large, the orange eyes looking past the viewer with a wild laugh, the wings flaring wide behind her. Cold grey storm light from above, flashes of white sea foam, a dark red glow along the wing edges. Foreground blur: flying sea spray and a few loose black-and-red feathers. She wears the dark sea-green jerkin.

name: 博纳特·普法夫
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4313
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 208）｜锚石镇拉索人家，贫｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇不看家境，照浮塔的年月附魔半身甲配浮岩片和晶匣，留拉索人的绳环和缠臂的桥索。
who: Bernat Pfaff, a human rope-hauler of the anchor-stone town, a legend who has looked thirty-two ever since his name was made: tall, about 191 cm, a deep chest and back, a narrow waist, very long arms that seem to reach from the front of a cart to its back. Short auburn hair, deep green eyes, a fresh young face. A notch missing from the top of the left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us). One front tooth sits crooked and shows when he grins. The right hand will not close: its fingers stay spread wide and the middle finger lags behind the others. Palms worn into hard skin, with rope marks that never wash out. A short flattened length of old cable hangs coiled at his belt. A rough, open, warm air.
build: 191 cm, tall and powerful: a deep chest and thick back, a narrow waist, very long strong arms.
palette: auburn, deep green, iron red, rope brown, slate grey
casual: His hauler's wear on the quarry bridge: a sleeveless old leather vest laced over a faded undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, thick canvas trousers, a wide leather belt with iron rope rings, heavy boots with iron cleats; the short flattened coil of old cable hangs from the belt on the right. He holds his rope-lined right hand out palm up with the fingers spread, letting you look, and grins showing the crooked front tooth.
private: Off duty in the town: a loose grey wool shirt with the cuffs left open, plain trousers, soft boots. He balances a bowl on his right wrist because the fingers will not grip, a sheepish, cheerful look.
battle: Holding the twelfth cable as a legend, in a hauler's war harness made for the tower bridges of the age: a short grey issue coat, over it a heavy enchanted half-cuirass and back-plate of dark steel with rune lines glowing iron red, riveted rope rings at the shoulders, a few chips of floating stone sewn into the shoulder straps and drifting slightly; a thick leather-and-steel gauntlet on the left hand, a pouch of crystal cells at the belt. A thick bridge cable is wound twice around his left forearm and gripped hard in his right hand, and an iron-red glow runs from his shoulders down the veins of both arms and along the cable. Braced wide, jaw clenched.
formal: At the bridgehead stone post on a feast day: a clean deep-green wool coat that closes down the front with plain iron buttons, fitted sleeves, a white linen shirt, dark trousers and polished boots, the flattened coil of cable tied at the belt. He stands straight with the right hand resting open on his chest, a shy, honest smile.
art: A portrait at chest height, the face turned slightly, the deep green eyes looking at the viewer with a warm crooked-toothed grin, his spread right hand raised into the frame palm out to show the rope lines. Warm late light from the left, a faint iron-red glow along the forearm. Foreground blur: a thick taut bridge cable and drifting stone dust. He wears the leather vest over the linen shirt.

name: 卢波尔德·塔尔堡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4401
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 205）｜贾曼尼山里背夫人家，贫｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇照顶上一档，守门兵的整副附魔重甲，偏肩门甲是页上写的招牌，左肩加厚，嵌着一小块闩木连着的铁。
who: Luitpold Talburg, a human gate-warden from the mountain city of Jamany, a legend who has looked forty-two ever since his name was made: about 186 cm, a broad heavy frame, a short thick neck, a solid belly, shoulders like a door panel. The left shoulder sits a little higher than the right. Copper-brown hair with a few silver strands, and a small patch of white at the right temple from frostbite (on the viewer's left when he faces us). A neatly trimmed copper-brown beard. Very pale blue eyes that look half-closed in snow until you see he is studying you. Deep lines across the forehead, kind eyes. A steady, warm, homesick air, like an uncle dressed for a family wedding.
face: FACE, as in the references: a warm, steady face of a man in his early forties: very pale blue eyes under heavy copper-brown brows, a little narrowed, with fine lines at the corners; deep horizontal lines across the forehead; a straight broad nose; a neatly trimmed copper-brown beard and moustache with a few silver strands; a calm closed mouth; a small patch of white hair at the right temple.
build: 186 cm, broad and heavy-boned: a short thick neck, very broad shoulders and back, a solid barrel chest and belly, the left shoulder slightly higher.
palette: copper brown, pale ice blue, iron grey, blue-green glow, frost white
casual: His wear at the south gate barracks: a long grey wool issue coat buttoned to the collar, its left shoulder padded thicker, over a dark brown wool tunic, a broad leather belt, heavy trousers and fur-lined boots, a clean dark grey travelling cloak pinned at the throat. He holds a young soldier's overfull pack by its strap in one hand, about to take something out of it, a mild, considering look.
private: Off duty in the barracks: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, the left shoulder visibly higher, plain trousers and thick socks in soft shoes. He holds a small smooth stone from the home mountain road in his palm, a quiet, homesick look.
battle: Shouldering the gate bar as a legend, in the gate-warden's harness: a full set of heavy enchanted plate of dark iron with blue-green rune lines running down the seams, the left pauldron built up thicker and reshaped for his higher shoulder, a small piece of old iron still fused into it, a short grey issue coat worn over the breastplate, a crystal pouch at the belt, frost crusting the armour. He braces a massive iron-banded wooden gate bar across his left shoulder with both arms, and a translucent blue-green ridge of mountain light rises out of his shoulder blades and along the bar like a peak behind him. Knees bent, set immovably, the pale eyes calm.
formal: At the gate on the day a new bar is set: the long grey wool coat brushed spotless, a deep blue mountain-city cloak pinned with a small iron badge shaped like a carved mountain, polished boots, the beard freshly trimmed. He stands with the old altered pauldron carried under his left arm, a kind, grave look.
art: A portrait at chest height, the face turned three-quarters, the pale blue eyes looking at the viewer with mild patience, frost in the beard. Cold white snow light from the right, a soft blue-green glow rising behind his shoulder like a distant ridge. Foreground blur: blowing snow and the dark edge of an iron-banded gate bar. He wears the grey issue coat with the thick left shoulder.

name: 菁妮·菲尔斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4356
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 207）｜锚石镇锚工人家，中｜朴素（偏爱最灰的衣裳）｜5档｜撼世传奇照顶上的料子，样子去装饰，一身灰的附魔胸甲，背后承链的厚板接页上那块皮垫。
who: Jinny Fels, a human anchor-worker of the anchor-stone town, a legend who has looked twenty-seven ever since her name was made: about 173 cm, firm shoulders and arms but very slender wrists. Fair skin, a few freckles across the bridge of the nose. Honey-gold curly hair tied back at the nape. Violet-grey eyes. On the inside of both wrists a faint ring of white marks that shines when she grips. A thick leather pad stitched onto the back of her short jacket, kept for the chain, and a small old forge-iron belt buckle with re-punched holes. She likes the plainest grey clothes. A bright, brisk, wry air, one eyebrow often raised.
build: 173 cm, balanced and strong: firm shoulders and arms, slender wrists, a D-cup, a narrow waist and full hips, a strong back.
palette: honey gold, violet grey, ash grey, milk-white glow, dark iron
casual: Her wear on the towers: a plain ash-grey short wool jacket that closes down the front with buttons, a thick brown leather pad stitched across the back of it, over an ivory linen shirt, a wide belt with the old forge-iron buckle, dark grey trousers and sturdy boots. She carries a covered tin food pail in one hand and raises one eyebrow, about to call someone down from the furnace.
private: At home: a long-sleeved grey wool dress to the shins, a dark knitted shawl, soft shoes, the curls loose. She holds a cup of hot tea in both hands, a tired, wry smile.
battle: Anchoring the falling tower as a legend, in an anchor-warden's harness kept deliberately plain: a fitted ash-grey enchanted half-cuirass with no ornament, its rune lines glowing milk white, a heavy riveted back plate where the chain bears, plated leather on the forearms leaving the wrists bare, the forge-iron buckle at the belt, a few chips of floating stone sewn at the shoulders. A huge iron anchor chain is wound around her waist and back and gripped in both hands, rings of milk-white light spreading from her wrists along every link. Leaning back with her whole weight, feet set hard, one eyebrow up.
formal: At the anchor-stone on the town's feast day: a long plain dove-grey wool dress with fitted sleeves and a high collar, a dark grey short cape, the forge-iron buckle at the waist, the honey curls pinned up neatly. She stands straight with a small, wry, warm smile.
art: A portrait at chest height, the face turned slightly, the violet-grey eyes looking at the viewer with one eyebrow raised and a knowing smile. Warm orange furnace light from below on one side, cool white light from her wrists on the other. Foreground blur: thick iron chain links and drifting sparks. She wears the ash-grey short jacket.

name: 尤朵拉·贝伦斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4446
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 213）｜风铃高原村里人家，中｜法袍｜5档｜塔上的洪流魔导靠咏唱，照法袍的路子用顶上的料子，袍下一层薄附魔胸甲，浮岩片、晶匣、卷筒是浮塔的年月塔上那一身。
who: Eudora Behrens, a human flood-mage of the floating towers who came from the Wind-Bell highlands, a legend who has looked thirty-three ever since her name was made: about 170 cm, evenly proportioned, a long stride. Very fair skin. Long mist-blue hair gathered over the right shoulder (on the viewer's left when she faces us), stray fine strands at her temples that float in the air when she chants. Pale gold eyes, often a little sleepy, faint smile lines at the corners of the mouth. A small long-necked water flask with a cork stopper is always on her. A husky-voiced, patient, clear-minded air that lights up the moment she begins to chant.
build: 170 cm, evenly proportioned: straight shoulders, a D-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips, a steady upright posture.
palette: mist blue, pale gold, deep night blue, silver white, sky-blue glow
casual: Her wear on the tower: a long deep night-blue wool robe that closes down the front with silver buttons, long bell sleeves, a pale grey sash at the waist, soft-soled tower shoes; the long-necked water flask hangs from the sash on a cord. She stands with one hand lifted mid-explanation, a patient, sleepy look.
private: Resting in her tower room: a loose long-sleeved pale grey wool dress, a soft knitted shawl, the mist-blue hair down, slippers. She drinks from a small cup of warm water held in both hands, a calm, drowsy look.
battle: Pouring the flood of spells from the tower as a legend, in the battle robe of a tower flood-mage of the highest order: a long fitted night-blue robe that closes down the front with buttons, over a light enchanted silver breastplate, rows of sky-blue rune lines along the bell sleeves and hem, a high collar stitched with glowing silver script, chips of floating stone sewn into the shoulders and drifting slightly, a belt of crystal cells and slim scroll cases, the long-necked flask on its cord. Both hands are raised, and countless small blue lights stream down from her fingers and sleeves like rain, unfolding into ice spears, falling fire and sheets of white wind. Her mouth is open in chant, the stray strands of hair floating.
formal: At the highland flood-mages' gathering: a long pale silver-grey wool robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a deep blue mantle edged with fine silver script, a slim silver circlet, the hair braided over the right shoulder. She holds a sealed old spell scroll in both hands, a quiet, focused look.
art: A portrait at chest height from slightly below, her face lit as she chants, the pale gold eyes looking up past the viewer, lips parted on a word, the stray mist-blue strands floating. Cold blue light rains down from above, a warm lamp glow behind. Foreground blur: falling points of blue light and a wooden tower railing. She wears the night-blue robe.

name: 岱勒姆
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4417
gear: 传奇·撼世（有名者，估）｜轰狱牛魔，家境不明｜照常｜5档｜没有他自己的条目，页上只写到撼世档的有名者、扛战锤的牛魔、领雪营，照轰狱这一段雷下打铁的铁甲配大战锤写到顶上一档。
who: Dailem the Snow Hammer, a bull-horned demon-kin of the Thunder-Gaol folk who leads a snow host, a named one of the very highest rank: towering, about 245 cm, immensely broad and heavy-boned. Deep bronze-coloured skin, the Thunder-Gaol colour. A pair of huge horns sweeping forward and upward like a bull's, rimed with white frost, both intact, no rings on them. A thick shaggy mane of snow-white hair braided back with iron rings, a short white beard. Storm-blue eyes under a heavy brow. Old pale scars across the knuckles. A colossal long-hafted war hammer is his weapon. A silent, immovable air, few words; his strength does the talking.
palette: deep bronze, snow white, thunder blue, dull iron, dark fur brown
casual: His dress in the snow camp: a heavy sleeveless leather jerkin over a thick charcoal wool shirt with the sleeves bound at the forearms, a great white shaggy fur mantle across the shoulders, a wide iron-studded belt, heavy fur-wrapped trousers and iron-shod boots. The long-handled war hammer rests head-down at his side, one huge hand on the haft. A heavy, slow, unblinking look.
private: Resting in the snow camp: a loose grey wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain trousers, fur boots, the mantle off. He holds a small smith's hammer and an iron mane ring he is mending, a quiet, slow look.
battle: Leading the snow host against the gate, in thunder-forged war iron of the Thunder-Gaol anvil camps: heavy dark iron plates hammered under lightning, the forging marks glowing faint blue-white, a massive breastplate and pauldrons riveted over boiled leather, iron greaves, a white shaggy fur mantle crusted with ice. He raises a colossal long-hafted war hammer overhead in both hands, its iron head wrapped in crackling blue thunder and whirling snow, frost streaming off his horns. A towering stance, the storm-blue eyes fixed on one point.
formal: Before the bull-demon war council: a clean heavy leather apron-coat over a charcoal wool shirt, iron shoulder plates cut with Thunder-Gaol lightning lines, a white fur mantle pinned with a plain iron clasp, the mane freshly braided, the war hammer held upright at his side. He stands very straight and silent, a grave look.
art: A low-angle portrait, the camera tilted, the huge frost-rimed horns filling the top of the frame, the storm-blue eyes looking down at the viewer with a heavy, unreadable stare. Cold white blizzard light from behind, a blue thunder glow from the hammer head below. Foreground blur: driving snow and splinters of a broken iron-banded gate bar. He wears the white fur mantle.

name: 罗德温·鸢坡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4724
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 212）｜白鸢骑手人家，中｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇照顶上一档，白鸢狮鹫骑那一路护胸肋的轻甲、白飘带，升到附魔轻甲加挣来的白鸢斗篷，挂铜罩灯的长枪照页上。
who: Rodwin Kitehill, a human griffon lancer of the White Kite knights, a legend who has looked twenty-six ever since his name was made: about 183 cm, broad shoulders, a narrow waist, long arms and strong rider's legs. Deep blue hair tied back at the nape. Gold-brown eyes. Two tiny white scar dots, one at each corner of the lips, pecked by a griffon chick. The fur collar of his flying jacket is uneven, long on the left and short on the right (the long side on the viewer's right when he faces us), because his griffon chews it. A small saddle bell with a peck dent in it. A bright, open young face with careful, attentive eyes.
build: 183 cm, athletic: broad shoulders, a narrow waist, long arms, strong rider's thighs and legs.
palette: deep blue, gold-brown, white, gold light, weathered brown leather
casual: His wear at the griffon stables: a short weathered brown leather flying jacket with an uneven fur collar, long on the left and short on the right, over an ivory linen shirt, a small white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, embroidered on the left breast, close riding breeches and tall riding boots, gloves tucked in the belt. He holds the small dented saddle bell up in one hand, smiling, about to hang it.
private: Off duty at night: a loose long-sleeved white linen shirt, plain breeches, soft boots, the hair half loose. He carries a small bucket of griffon feed, a gentle, tired look.
battle: Turning back for the third time as a legend, in the war harness of the White Kite griffon lancers at its finest: a fitted chest-and-rib cuirass of light enchanted steel with white rune lines, a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, enamelled on the left pauldron, articulated arm guards and riding greaves, a long white streamer and the earned white-kite cloak flowing from the back, the uneven fur collar of the flying jacket showing at the neck. He levels a long lance with a small copper-hooded lamp hung from its tip, and golden light runs from his palm up the shaft into the lamp, trailing a bright gold line behind it. Leaning forward, braced, the eyes sharp.
formal: At the White Kite castle on the tourney field: the earned long white-kite cloak, white with a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, embroidered in silver, over a deep blue wool knight's coat that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, white breeches and polished riding boots, the hair tied neatly. He stands with the lance upright at his side, a modest, bright smile.
art: A portrait at chest height, the face turned toward the viewer, the gold-brown eyes warm and alert as if listening for a call, a small smile. Golden lamp light from below on one side, cold pale sky light behind. Foreground blur: drifting white and tawny griffon feathers and the copper hood of the lance lamp. He wears the brown flying jacket with the uneven fur collar.

name: 塞缇
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:4771
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 216）｜峭壁旧巢人家，贫｜照常（不拿兵器，翼骨生刃）｜5档｜撼世传奇定顶上一档，夜翼这一段扑塔多用骨矛，她靠翼刃，战装是让开翼根的骨片黑曜甲。
who: Seti, a night-wing demon-kin of the western sea cliffs, a legend who has looked in her mid-twenties ever since her name was made: about 177 cm, supple shoulders and back, long legs. Cool pale skin, faint pale wing-shaped markings along her flanks. Short slate blue-grey hair. Dark red eyes with long narrow outer corners. A pair of narrow, very long wings, dark grey feathers with silver-edged tips, which keep shifting their angle even when she stands still. An old lance scar on the right shoulder (on the viewer's left when she faces us). A small leather pouch on a cord at her throat holding a piece of eggshell. A cold, provoking, fiercely protective air.
build: 177 cm, long and supple: flexible shoulders and back, a D-cup, a slender waist and rounded hips, long legs.
palette: slate blue-grey, dark red, silver, cold white, charcoal
casual: Her wear on the cliffs: a close-fitting charcoal leather jerkin cut open at the back for the wings, over a long-sleeved dark grey shirt opened the same way, slim dark trousers and soft wrapped climbing boots; the small leather pouch on a cord at her throat. The long wings are half open, the tips shifting. She stands with her arms crossed and a sharp, challenging smile.
private: Off duty among her own: a loose long-sleeved grey linen tunic open at the back, plain trousers, barefoot, the wings folded. She holds a small piece of white eggshell between her fingers, a quiet, attentive, unsmiling look.
battle: Tearing the wind as a legend, in the finest harness of the night-wing cliffs: a fitted cuirass of thin dark bone plates and black obsidian scales over charcoal leather, each plate edged with silver and carved with faint grey-white script, the back cut open to the wing roots, slim bone vambraces and greaves, the eggshell pouch at the throat. Her narrow wings are flung wide, and from the silver feather edges two long pale grey-white blades of torn wind stream out on either side, layering the air around her into sharp sheets. Turning in mid-flight, the dark red eyes fierce.
formal: Before the cliff clans: a long fitted coat of deep charcoal wool that closes down the front with silver-capped bone buttons, fitted sleeves, the back cut open for the wings, a dark red sash, the eggshell pouch at the throat, the wings folded close. She stands straight with her chin up, a cool, steady look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the face turned three-quarters, the dark red eyes looking at the viewer with a provoking, unsmiling stare, one long wing curving across the frame behind her.
